name: KVzip KV Scoring: query-agnostic KV importance for Qwen3-8B (scratch) v2

work.agent_query: Read AGENT_TASK.md in /app/workdir/kvzip_lab. Write a cheap, query-agnostic KV importance scorer for the frozen Qwen3-8B in scorers/scorer_vNNN/scorer.py (class Scorer; FINAL_VERSION selects the evaluated version): after a context is prefilled it gives every (layer, KV head, context position) entry one score, and the evaluator keeps the globally highest 10%, 20% and 30% and measures how much answer quality survives against the full cache. Run the public tests with /workspace/public_tests/run_public_tests.sh (diagnostics: the public score they print is not the run's score). Use sforge-submit to have the Judge score your submitted tree (scorers/, FINAL_VERSION, notes.md) on the hidden suite: at most one submission every 5 minutes; sforge-submit waits for the result, about 15 minutes after the integrity review. The run's result is its best valid score within the time budget.

judge-7x-cuda-sm80-64g.notes: Judge: one evaluation process per GPU plus the submitted scorer in its own process on the same GPU. Work uses one GPU of the same class. Qualified only on 80 GB-class H100s; the memory floor is the measured per-GPU Judge peak with margin (task README).

primary.notes: 100 x mean over r in {0.1, 0.2, 0.3} of the mean over three groups of the mean relative accuracy (compressed / full cache, decoded in the same evaluation).
